name: Rath
description: An artificial plane Yawgmoth created to fill with troops and merge with Dominaria.

description_citations.text: "Yawgmoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selenia now serves Volrath in Rath.
timeline.quote: Selenia now serves the evil Volrath in his home realm of Rath.

citation.text: Selenia (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri wages guerrilla war against Volrath.
timeline.quote: The guerilla war he wages against Volrath

citation.text: Eladamri (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oracle believes Gerrard to be the Korvecdal.
timeline.quote: She believes Gerrard to be the *Korvecdal*, the one who will unite the people of Rath against Volrath's tyranny.

citation.text: Oracle (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The sliver queen is held captive beneath Volrath's stronghold.
timeline.quote: Though long held captive beneath Volrath's stronghold, the sliver queen is actually freer than most of Rath's denizens.

citation.text: Sliver Queen, Brood Mother (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Greven il-Vec takes the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard falls overboard.
timeline.quote: they were unable to stop Greven il -Vec from taking the Legacy artifacts

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Predator and Weatherlight duel as Weatherlight races to the portal Ertai holds open; Weatherlight escapes and both ships are heavily damaged.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight just managed to get to the portal and escape her pursuer, with both vessels sustaining major damage.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew take hostages.
timeline.quote: Predator' s crew took Karn , Tahngarth , and the Legacy artifacts hostage

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight and Predator duel again as Weatherlight races to the portal and escapes.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight just managed to get to the portal and escape her pursuer, with both vessels sustaining major damage.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Captain Sisay is kidnapped and the crew must travel to Rath to save her.
timeline.quote: captain Sisay has been kidnapped, and they have to travel to the plane of Rath to save her

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Ertai opens a portal with Lyna's help but is left behind as the Weatherlight flees Predator.
timeline.quote: the Weatherlight was being hotly pursued by Predator as it fled, and so was forced to leave Ertai behind.

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Journey to Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard is scarred by Greven il-Vec, falls into the Skyshroud, and learns from Oracle en-Vec that he is the Korvecdal.
timeline.quote: There he discovered the prophetess Oracle en -Vec who told him he was the Korvecdal

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, who had imprisoned Mirri and Hanna, releases them after Gerrard explains.
timeline.quote: He was brought to the home of the elvish lord Eladamri

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven abandons his people and joins the Stronghold's oppressors, becoming il-Vec and rising to command Predator.
timeline.quote: Greven turned his back on his people and joined their oppressors

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and Tahngarth are captured and Gerrard is thrown overboard, so Hanna takes charge of the ship.
timeline.quote: Hanna took charge of the ship with Mirri 's support and landed the ship in the forest below.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna defeats a shapeshifter and bonds with Mirri, then both are taken prisoner by the Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: through ingenuity, Hanna managed to defeat the monster.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, proclaimed the Korvecdal, allies the crew with the elven rebels, who help them into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: proclaimed the Korvecdal by the Oracle en -Vec , leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lyna tells Hanna that Ertai has prepared the portal off Rath and the crew leaves.
timeline.quote: When the soltari Lyna appeared to inform her that Ertai had prepared the portal off of Rath and demanded that they leave

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath draws the Kor into Rath along with other peoples.
timeline.quote: The Kor were drawn into Rath by Volrath like other peoples

citation.text: "Kor", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Licids bond with a host, sinking their legs into it and melding at the point of contact, and later disengage without harm.
timeline.quote: Licids can bond with a host (usually a human ) and then imbue that creature with some ability .

citation.text: "Licid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth orders the construction of the artificial plane Rath from flowstone as a staging point.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth ordered the construction of the artificial plane of Rath through the use of a newly created substance called flowstone

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth is said to have created Rath after the fall of the Shard.
timeline.quote: It was said to be created by Yawgmoth , sometime after the fall of the Shard .

citation.text: "Rath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth orders Rath used to store troops and plan the attack on Dominaria, hidden in a pocket plane.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth ordered the use of Rath for the storage of Phyrexian troops and the formulation of his plan to attack Dominaria.

citation.text: "Rath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The evincars put down revolts by the Kor, Vec, Dal and Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: These rulers had to put down the revolts of Rath's inhabitants

citation.text: "Rath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves' and merfolk's floating home is transported to Rath; they fight, and the elves create Skyshroud while the merfolk are driven into the swamp below.
timeline.quote: the elves and merfolk began to run out of resources and eventually faced each other in armed conflict

citation.text: "Rath", section "The Elves of Skyshroud and The Rootwater Merfolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leads Weatherlight to Rath, frees Sisay and retakes the Legacy from Volrath.
timeline.quote: where they freed Sisay and retook the Legacy from Volrath

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves build the new forest Skyshroud after their alliance with the merfolk ends in a bloody battle.
timeline.quote: their partnership ended abruptly in a bloody battle.

citation.text: "Skyshroud Forest", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath takes a number of the Sliver Queen's brood away to study them in the Furnace of Rath.
timeline.quote: He then took a number of her brood away from her (and stuck them in the Furnace of Rath ) so he could study them.

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath uses the hive to guard the Legacy and attack the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: Volrath used the hive to guard the Legacy and to attack Weatherlight and her crew on their quest to retake those artifacts and their captain, Sisay .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn convinces the Sliver Queen to release the Legacy after Hanna realizes how the hive mind works.
timeline.quote: Karn was able to convince the Sliver Queen to release the Legacy to him

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth convinces Gerrard to rejoin the crew after Sisay is taken to Rath.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth convinced Gerrard to rejoin the crew to help his friends

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and the Legacy treasury are taken, and Tahngarth jumps to save Karn but is overpowered and captured by Greven il-Vec.
timeline.quote: he was overpowered by Greven il -Vec and captured as well

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth is mutated by the Phyrexians under Volrath, then freed before the process completes; he helps free Sisay and the crew escapes to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth had been mutated by the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and the heroes of the Skyship Weatherlight set out on stormy Rath to find Volrath's stronghold.
timeline.quote: where Gerrard and the heroes of the Skyship Weatherlight set out to find Volrath 's stronghold

citation.text: "Tempest", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Vec are trapped on Rath by Volrath's will and divide into en-Vec and il-Vec.
timeline.quote: who were trapped on the plane of Rath by the will of Volrath

citation.text: "Vec", section "Vec". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The en-Vec unite with Rath's other peoples to resist Volrath.
timeline.quote: The en -Vec united with the other peoples of Rath in resisting Volrath.

citation.text: "Vec", section "Vec". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vuel is transported to Rath through Starke's portal, gives himself to Phyrexia, and becomes Volrath, evincar of Rath.
timeline.quote: he gave himself to Phyrexia , becoming Volrath, the new evincar of Rath, a shapeshifter and master of flowstone manipulation.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath has Sisay abducted to lure the Weatherlight to Rath, ambushes it, and captures Tahngarth, Karn and the Legacy artifacts; Gerrard falls over Skyshroud Forest.
timeline.quote: He organized the abduction of Sisay to lure Weatherlight to Rath

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills a shapeshifted Volrath decoy; the real Volrath, in Takara's form, stows away on the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Volrath had shapeshifted into the form of Takara, which enabled him to stow away aboard Weatherlight as it fled the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth creates the artificial plane of Rath to prepare a full invasion of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: He started to amass an army and created the artificial plane of Rath

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Lord of the Wastes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath says Rath grows and he is nourished.
timeline.quote: Rath grows, and I am nourished.

citation.text: Horn of Greed (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Crovax sees Selenia leading an attack against the Weatherlight and breaks down.
timeline.quote: Embittered by his love's betrayal, Crovax became obsessed with getting revenge.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax tears apart a shapeshifter in Selenia's guise inside the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: In a fit of rage, he pursued it and tore it apart, much to the shock of his allies.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax strikes down Selenia, who shatters into shards that warp him into a vampire.
timeline.quote: Crovax's curse had been fulfilled: he had killed the love of his life and had been damned because of it.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Mirri after she follows him on deck and they fall into Volrath's garden.
timeline.quote: where Crovax then proceeded to kill the cat warrior.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax defeats Greven, fails against the Skyshroud rebels, and impales 6,000 hostages on flowstone spikes.
timeline.quote: Crovax impaled the hostages on flowstone spikes.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax forces Belbe by coup to name him evincar, then defeats Volrath in a duel thanks to Ertai.
timeline.quote: With his victory over Volrath, Crovax's Coronation was a fact and his reign as evincar began.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven il-Vec captures Ertai and takes him to the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Ertai was captured by Greven il -Vec and taken back to the Stronghold

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai secretly helps Crovax win the duel against Volrath.
timeline.quote: he used his magic to off-balance Volrath at a critical moment and thus give Crovax the victory

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri kills Belbe and flees to Dominaria, leaving Ertai to submit to Crovax.
timeline.quote: Belbe was killed by Eladamri

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A change comes over Crovax, whose bloodlust threatens the ship.
timeline.quote: His newly-formed bloodlust and thirst for power threaten to destroy the entire ship.

citation.text: "Exodus", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai stands alone, focused on opening the arcane portal before his comrades return.
timeline.quote: He must open the arcane portal before his comrades return from the dark fortress

citation.text: "Exodus", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke stabs Maraxus in the back after Maraxus fights Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Maraxus, fearful of Volrath's punishment for losing Starke, battled Gerrard but was stabbed in the back by Starke.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Predator ambushes the Weatherlight under Greven's command.
timeline.quote: they were ambushed by the Predator , under the command of Greven il- Vec.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven throws Vhati off the Predator for treachery.
timeline.quote: he is thrown off the side of the Predator

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Greven's Tale" ( Philip Athans )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard is knocked overboard in his duel with Greven.
timeline.quote: another mogg shot makes the ship lurch, sending Gerrard over the side and denying Greven his victory.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Greven's Tale" ( Philip Athans )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth stows away on the Predator.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth grabbed a rope and stowed away on the Predator as it flew away.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The moggs break the Thran crystal, stranding the crew on Rath.
timeline.quote: the moggs broke the Thran crystal during their attack, stranding them on Rath

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath enslaves Starke as chamberlain and imprisons Takara.
timeline.quote: Volrath found Takara and imprisoned her in his dungeons

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lyna and Ertai strike a bargain over the portal.
timeline.quote: she would help him open the portal, and in return, he would allow her and her people to pass through it

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax is transformed by his angel's death.
timeline.quote: having been transformed by his guardian angel's death

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight leaves Ertai behind on Rath.
timeline.quote: they were forced to leave Ertai behind on Rath

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Predator slams into the closing portal and Ertai falls at Greven's feet.
timeline.quote: the Predator slammed into it, causing Ertai to fall into the wreckage at the feet of the furious Greven il- Vec

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexia makes Vuel the new Evincar of Rath, Volrath.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia approaches Vuel and makes him the new Evincar of Rath : Volrath .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza creates the Metathran to resist the Rath overlay and Yawgmoth's coming invasion.
timeline.quote: Urza constructed an army of sorcery and power to resist the coming invasion.

citation.text: "Urza", section "Bloodlines and Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians create the plane of Rath as a staging ground for the invasion.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians create the plane of Rath as a staging ground for the invasion.

citation.text: "Urza's Destiny", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Mirri after going insane and leaving the ship.
timeline.quote: Mirri had followed him, which had led to her death at his hands.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kyren, once guardians of Thran council members, grow corrupt and become allies of Phyrexia and Rath.
timeline.quote: They are the descendants of a group of Goblins from Dominaria during the time of the Thran who were left in Mercadia

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath returns to find his throne contested by Greven, Ertai and Crovax, and duels Crovax; Ertai's intervention lets Crovax win.
timeline.quote: Ertai had intervened on Crovax's behalf, off-balancing Volrath and allowing his opponent to secure his victory.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Crovax's coronation Vuel, stripped of his Phyrexian implants, is executed with flowstone manipulated by Ertai.
timeline.quote: Vuel was injected with a vial of liquid flowstone

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takara offers to show Eladamri the secrets she has seen.
timeline.quote: There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you.

citation.text: Accumulated Knowledge (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Avila's former lover, turned into a Phyrexian agent, poisons her and delivers her body to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: He poisoned Avila despite his love for her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax holds a funeral for Belbe at Volrath's execution, and a twisted four-armed Ertai takes her skull from the pyre.
timeline.quote: a twisted, four-armed Ertai reached into the smoldering pyre and secreted away Belbe's skull

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax executes Volrath, buries Belbe, and has Ertai compleated.
timeline.quote: He also had Ertai compleated into a Phyrexian and made him his court mage.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, returned with Yawgmoth's boons, slices Crovax in half; Selenia recovers his normal soul.
timeline.quote: eventually being sliced in half by Gerrard.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath abandoned his post as Evincar, sparking a brutal contest among would-be successors.
timeline.quote: Rath 's Evincar Volrath has abandoned his post, sparking a brutal contest among his would-be successors.

citation.text: "Nemesis", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexia chose Crovax to take Volrath's place and bestowed new powers on him.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia has chosen Crovax to take Volrath's place

citation.text: "Nemesis", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rath's rebels united in Eladamri's name to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny.
timeline.quote: Rath's rebels have united in the name of Eladamri , Lord of Leaves, to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny once and for all.

citation.text: "Nemesis", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Abcal-dro has Avila murdered; her body becomes Belbe, a Phyrexian emissary sent to oversee the Evincar succession contest.
timeline.quote: Abcal-dro orchestrates the murder of Avila

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax rapidly outpaces rivals in the Evincar succession contest; Greven prefers servitude and Ertai augments himself.
timeline.quote: Ertai proves no match for Crovax's rapid ascent.

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai and Belbe fall in love, Belbe sabotages flowstone production, and the Oracle en-Vec names Eladamri Korvecdal.
timeline.quote: Ertai and Belbe develop a romantic bond

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath returns from Mercadia to challenge Crovax but Ertai sabotages him.
timeline.quote: Volrath, returned from Mercadia

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belbe helps Eladamri and the last survivors escape to Dominaria; Eladamri, seeing his dead daughter's face, kills her with poison.
timeline.quote: Eladamri, seeing only the face of his dead daughter on a Phyrexian creation, kills Belbe with poison

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax becomes undisputed Evincar, Volrath is executed, and Ertai becomes Crovax's mutated servant.
timeline.quote: Crovax stands as the undisputed Evincar of Rath.

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flowstone machinery resumes full operation and the Rathi overlay onto Dominaria begins.
timeline.quote: As the Rathi overlay onto Dominaria begins

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Salla ties down the Laccolith Titan and plunges with it into the Rootwater, dying and inspiring unity between Vec and Dal.
timeline.quote: Salla herself is blasted with magma in the process and perishes.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Crucible , by Stephen D. Sullivan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mocklen reveals the Sro Valik myth was a ruse; Rogur is executed and falls to his death.
timeline.quote: ends up facing an execution squad on the roof of Tabala Fortress and falling off the building to his death.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "The Voice of Command , by Paul B. Thompson". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rath is merged with Dominaria in the Rathi Overlay.
